processOverrideReason: V1.17 White overrides kept (3 support interface layers at 0.15 spacing, 0.2 top z, interface 40 mm/s, bridge 30 mm/s, support ironing, 0.2 first layer): the cap prints roof-down on tree support as V1.17, the saddle body on tree support as V1.30, the face and the speaker box flat without support. Its dimensions come from the ROBOTIS OMX-F CAD (face-u20/robotis-cad/): lens front 22.0 mm in front of the board, ring dia 14.0. The bosses grow from 4.0 to 13.1 mm behind the face back (dia 4.8, pilot dia 1.7, wall 1.55) so the board sits at x 67.0 and the lens front at x 89.0, 0.4 mm behind the trim front (Shawn 2026-10-23: "板子后移 6.6 mm"); the eye opening grows to dia 16.2, with the same 45 deg flare outside. Front face otherwise unchanged (checks.json frontUnchangedOutsideBore). Four M2 x 6 into the bosses (C-camera-01..04), 4.4 mm of thread. The two side key pockets for the eye-trim tabs at (AY -/+ 7.7, AZ - 4.5) are filled through the 1.3 mm front skin: the bore cut into them, leaving 0.35 mm; the trim loses its two side tabs and the top key pair stays. Carried unprinted from V1.30 (same file, same pose).
